days.unit: enVision Math 2.0 Grade 5, Topic 2: Add and Subtract Decimals to Hundredths
days.standards: NVACS/CCSS.5.NBT.B.7: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value.
days.objective: Students will add decimals to hundredths by lining up place values and regrouping when needed.
days.targets:
I can line up decimals by place value before I add.
I can regroup tenths and hundredths when I add decimals.
I can check my sum with an estimate.
days.skills: Adding decimals to hundredths; regrouping; estimating to check reasonableness
days.vocab: decimal, tenths, hundredths, place value, regroup, estimate, sum
days.materials: enVision Student Edition Lesson 2-4, place-value charts, hundredths grids, whiteboards and markers, document camera
days.scaffolding: Place-value chart template with the decimal point pre-drawn; sentence frame: "First I line up the ___, then I add the ___." Hundredths grids for students who need a visual. ELL: vocabulary cards with pictures for tenths/hundredths; partner with a bilingual buddy.
days.anticipatory:
Anticipatory Set Activity (Whole Group) - 5 min
A science kit costs $12.45 and a magnifying glass costs $3.80. About how much do both cost? Students estimate on whiteboards ($12 + $4 = about $16) and hold them up.
days.i_do:
I do - 12 min
Model 12.45 + 3.80 on a place-value chart. Line up the decimal points, add hundredths (5 + 0 = 5), add tenths (4 + 8 = 12 tenths, regroup 1 one), add ones and tens. Sum: 16.25. Compare to the estimate of 16.
Think aloud: "Why does lining up the decimal points matter?"
days.we_do:
We do - 15 min
Solve together on whiteboards: 4.67 + 2.5 (7.17), 23.09 + 6.48 (29.57), 0.86 + 0.7 (1.56). Students estimate first, then solve.
Kagan: Rally Coach - Partner A solves while Partner B coaches and praises, then they switch for the next problem.
days.you_do:
You Do - 20 min
enVision Lesson 2-4 Independent Practice. Early finishers write their own decimal word problem for a partner.
Kagan: Round Robin - teams of four take turns explaining one problem's regrouping step.
days.independent_practice:
1) 5.36 + 2.41
2) 14.7 + 3.85
3) 0.99 + 0.08
4) Maya ran 2.75 km Monday and 3.6 km Tuesday. How far did she run in all?
days.wrap_up:
Wrap Up / Closure - 5 min
Exit ticket: 8.46 + 1.7. Show your estimate and your exact sum. Explain in one sentence where you regrouped.

days.unit: enVision Math 2.0 Grade 5, Topic 2: Add and Subtract Decimals to Hundredths
days.standards: NVACS/CCSS.5.NBT.B.7: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value.
days.objective: Students will subtract decimals to hundredths, regrouping and using zeros as placeholders.
days.targets:
I can line up decimals by place value before I subtract.
I can use a zero as a placeholder when the numbers have different decimal places.
I can check a difference by adding.
days.skills: Subtracting decimals to hundredths; regrouping across a decimal point; checking with addition
days.vocab: difference, placeholder, regroup, tenths, hundredths, inverse operation
days.materials: enVision Student Edition Lesson 2-5, place-value charts, hundredths grids, whiteboards, Quiz-Quiz-Trade cards
days.scaffolding: Placeholder-zero reminder card; color-coded columns on the place-value chart. ELL: sentence frame "I need to regroup because ___." Visual word wall for difference and placeholder.
days.anticipatory:
Anticipatory Set Activity (Whole Group) - 5 min
You have $20.00 and spend $7.35. Estimate your change. Turn and share how you estimated.
days.i_do:
I do - 12 min
Model 20.00 - 7.35 on a place-value chart. Write 20 as 20.00 so the places line up, then regroup across zeros. Difference: 12.65. Check: 12.65 + 7.35 = 20.00.
days.we_do:
We do - 15 min
Solve together: 9.4 - 3.27 (6.13), 15.06 - 8.5 (6.56), 3 - 1.42 (1.58).
Kagan: Numbered Heads Together - teams solve, make sure everyone can explain, then the teacher calls a number to share.
days.you_do:
You Do - 20 min
enVision Lesson 2-5 Independent Practice, problems chosen by teacher.
Kagan: Quiz-Quiz-Trade - students quiz each other with subtraction cards, then trade and find a new partner.
days.wrap_up:
Wrap Up / Closure - 5 min
Exit ticket: 6.2 - 2.75. Show the placeholder zero and check with addition.
